chapter: Ben Webster and Jim and Andy's
title: The Goodman legend: firing as a badge
summary: Hinton notes you haven't made it until you've played with Goodman and been fired.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: you've got something else to say -- Jimmy, you like me, we've all got some unforgettable stories. And I think some of the best stories about jazz musicians, some of the best names come out, the Benny Goodman stories are very famous, all of our associations with Benny Goodman. And there's a sort of saying going around, as you probably know, you haven't really made it in the business until you've played with Benny Goodman and had him fire you.
Seems like that. People keep going with him despite all the stories, young people keep taking jobs.
Sure. He's truly a legend and a tremendous player.
There are so many great stories about Benny that are funny and good, musicians' experiences with him. I think he goes down as one of the truly great characters of music.
